title: crumbkit/aliases-list/v1
description: The built-in aliases and the entries of the aliases file, with the problem of each entry that does not work.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page.

AliasRow.description: One built-in alias or aliases file entry, as `aliases list` prints it.

command.description: The command that the alias stands for, without the tool's name, such as `books list`. An entry's words are quoted for a POSIX shell, and the command is empty when the entry's value is not a list of words.

from.description: Where the alias comes from: the tool's name for a built-in alias, or the path of the aliases file for an entry.

name.description: The words that a person types after the tool's name, such as `books ls` for a built-in alias or `mine` for an entry of the aliases file.

problem.description: Why the entry does not expand, or empty when the alias works.
